name: com.midtrans.sdk.uikit.views.banktransfer.status.MandiriBillStatusActivity
description: After a user starts Mandiri Bill payments in Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen shows the payment result and the bill and company codes, expiry time, and payment instructions.
disableEffect: Disabling it can hide the Mandiri Bill payments payment result or the instructions needed to complete it.
